resources.string: Observe a leaf, choose an analysis route, and turn the assessment into informed care.
One image. Two analysis routes. A practical next step.
Cloud sends your selected image to the configured server. Offline uses the model on this device. Review the result and any available care guidance.
Review past scans, consult the disease library, or explore recorded trends. The sample result is a demonstration, not a live assessment.
Start with a clear leaf image. Choose where to analyze it, then review the assessment before deciding on care.
Take a photo or select one from your gallery. Analysis becomes available after an image is selected.
Check the preview for focus and lighting. You can replace the image before starting analysis.
Please wait while the selected image is processed. Image and route controls are temporarily unavailable.
Use even light, keep the leaf in focus, and make visible symptoms easy to see.
Uses an internet connection and sends the selected image to your configured server for analysis.
Runs the bundled model on this device without uploading the image. Results can differ from the cloud model.
The result shows the model assessment and care guidance when available. A prediction is not a confirmed diagnosis; consider visible symptoms and local expert advice.
